en: Friendly foes have appeared. Will you fight?

note: Debug/label line. Accuracy: black-square marker rendered '*' per the lead's convention (review_notes: square -> '*').
Debug/label line. Accuracy: marker '*' per the lead's convention. Term was set to 'Godshade' (Elm3 bestiary form) by the lead's pass; glossary entry still reads 'Divine Shadow' - lead to reconcile.

en:
The great shadow fades away.
Something has been left behind.{w}

note: Source text is the literal word 'item' followed by a full-width space, as if a template slot; translated as a generic line.

en: You obtained an item, but couldn't carry it.{w}

[Key Item]
You obtained a Piece of Grotesque Flesh.{w}
note: Kichouhin (valuables) rendered as 'Key Item'. Item name is new (not in glossary).

en:
[Key Item]
You obtained an Espel-Dex Business Card.{w}

[Key Item]
You obtained Tsakaro's Evil Eye.{w}
note: New name: Tsakaro (romanized). Item name not in glossary.

en:
[Key Item]
You obtained the Noble Lady's Eerie Wings.{w}
note: Item name not in glossary. 'You-yoku' = bewitching/eerie wing(s); singular or plural not settled.

en:
[Key Item]
You obtained the Great Emperor's Crown.{w}

note: Yomi (the land of the dead) water. Item name not in glossary.
Source variant has no final full stop; kept without one to mirror it.

en:
[Key Item]
You obtained the Prayer to the Revered One.{w}
note: Norito = ritual prayer/invocation. Item name not in glossary.

en:
[Key Item]
You obtained the Overlord Bull's Demon Horn.{w}
note: Item name not in glossary.

en:
[Key Item]
You obtained the Harz Crystal.{w}
note: New name: Harz (romanized from 'Haazu'; could be meant as Herz/Hearts). Not in glossary.

en:
[Key Item]
You obtained a Half-Drawn Map.{w}

note: New name: Nyoppurin (romanized). The name ends in 'purin' (pudding), a pun lost in English.

en:
[Key Item]
You obtained Ira's True Crystal.{w}
note: New name: Ira (romanized). Not in glossary.

en:
After defeating the mighty duke of the demon realm,
you found something.{w}

Having won the battle,
you found something.{w}

note: Seikaku here is the alignment stat (Good/Evil).
Source is already English in full-width letters; converted to ASCII, spelling kept.

en:
"Ah, they ran away!
Get back heeere! Hey, you!!"{w}
note: Mirco after the party flees the duel (row follows the duel label). 'They' = the party.

en:
"Say, Mirco.
Are you really sure it's this way?"{w}
note: Editorial: 'sure ... really' doubled up; moved 'really'.

en:
"How should I know?!
Hey, Hess. Use your magic to show us the map again."{w}
note: Chikei hyouji = a map-display spell. Editorial: stiff 'show us the lay of the land with magic' smoothed into a child's spoken line; still the terrain/map-display spell.

en:
"You may ask all you like,
but I've no magic power left, I'm afraid."{w}

"Then let's have tea and take a breather.
Drinking tea gets your magic back, right?"{w}

note: Trails off as in the source.

Hess-sama: no honorific (lead convention: Hess's gender is unknown, so no Master/Lord/Lady). No pronoun for Hess. Editorial: 'all six servings alone' was awkward; 6-nin-bun = six people's share, o-hitori de = Hess alone.

en: "...Gurtia, do you mean to torture me with tea?"{w}

"My feet hurt! My armor's heavy!
I'm tired! I hate this!"{w}

"That is quite enough!
And you call yourself a member of the proud House Lenzer?!"{w}
note: Editorial: idiom is 'And you call yourself...?!' (soredemo); 'Do you call yourself' read unidiomatic.

en: "That does it! This time, I won't let you off!"{w}
note: Accuracy: kyou to iu kyou wa = 'this time for sure / I've had it', not 'today of all days' (which implies a special day).
Music-note symbol dropped (not ASCII); '~!' keeps the sing-song tone. 'Him' = Mirco (male per glossary). Editorial: dropped the added '!' (not in source); music note -> '~' per the lead convention.

en:
"Grwaaah!
Knock that little shit's attitude into shape!{w}...No, knock it till it snaps!!"{w}
note: Kuso-gaki kept at full strength. Second line escalates from 'straighten out his spirit' to 'snap it'. Editorial: 'hammer ... attitude straight' was unidiomatic; kept the fix -> break escalation with a parallel verb.

en:
"My, my.
You seem to be having fun, young master."{w}

note: Mirco's plea to Hess, trailing off.

en:
"Please... wait...
I-I'm still... drinking my third cup...{w}Urp!"{w}
note: Editorial: 'I'm just now... drinking' read awkwardly; he is mid-way through the third cup.
He = Mirco.
Interrupted as in the source (he crashes into the party).

en:
"Ha ha ha! Not good enough, Master Mirco!!
Did you really think you could get away from Zephal?!{w}...Hm? And who might these people be?"{w}
note: Editorial: 'escape me, Zephal' read as if Zephal were addressing himself; third-person self-reference keeps the 'kono Zephal' boast.

en:
"I kind of bumped into them...
Um, are you all right?"{w}
note: First sentence to Zephal, second to the party.

en: "It appears they are people of this land."{w}

"Enemies?! Elpina, did you spot something?{w}...Ooh, first prey we've seen in ages!
Let's kill 'em quick and chow down!!"{w}
note: Editorial: 'fresh prey, first in ages' was clipped/awkward for spoken line.

en:
"Gurtia, Zapper! What is all this?!
Honestly, such a racket.{w}We are not here to play, so do behave a little..."{w}
note: Trails off as in the source.

en: "Look, Hess!{w}It's Master Mirco's first battle! Let's cheer him on!"{w}
note: Hess-sama: no honorific (lead convention, gender unknown).

en: "Never mind, never mind. Off you go now.{w}We'll be watching over you from right here!"{w}
"Huh? Just me?{w}Aren't you all going to fight with me?"{w}

note: Doro wo nuru (smear mud on) = tarnish/disgrace.
